name: Standing Up
overview: Scripture calls believers to stand firm both for themselves and for others, rooted in obedience and courage. Psalms 1:1 warns against standing in the way of sinners, emphasizing separation from ungodliness, while Ezekiel 2:1 and Ephesians 6:13 encourage standing on one's feet and wearing the full armor of God to withstand trials. Isaiah 58:1 exhorts believers to boldly proclaim truth, and John 16:33 assures peace through Christ despite tribulation. James 4:17 reminds us that knowing good and failing to act is sin, underscoring the responsibility to stand up rightly.
